_comment: Pinned external sources for the VOCAL.BIN music player. Neither is vendored in this repository.

tremor.name: citronalco/ps2-libtremor
tremor.description: Xiph Tremor (fixed-point Vorbis decoder), PS2 flavour. Linked into the VOCAL.BIN music player; not vendored in this repository.

ps2dev.name: ps2dev/ps2dev
ps2dev.description: PS2 toolchain (EE/IOP GCC + PS2SDK). Extract and pass its root as --toolchain; the tree must contain ee/, iop/ and ps2sdk/.
ps2dev.note: sha256 is of the macOS arm64 asset as downloaded 2026-11-05; other platforms' assets differ.
